description: Connects a subdomain (for example shop.example.com) to a Storly online store with a CNAME to Storly's storefront origin and a TXT record at _storly-verification under that subdomain, which proves which Storly store the domain owner approved. The zone apex and all other records are left untouched.
variableDescription: verifytoken: Storly's per-domain ownership token (32 lowercase hex characters), generated by Storly for the store connecting this domain and covered by the request signature.
